units: metres; glTF axes: x right, y up, -z front
notes: Masses are collider-hull volume x an effective density per class (gamedata.DENSITY): reasoned estimates, not sourced.
Static torques assume a two-leg stance at the rest pose (half the weight per planted leg). Hip yaw is 0.15 x hip pitch and ankle 0.05 x knee (reasoned).
Two meshes: the full glb and a decimated _lite glb (lods.lite); no baked normal maps. Godot's importer can still generate LODs from either.

parts[].hulls are the collision pieces (use these): one hull per part, except gamedata.SPLIT parts (receiver, barrel) cut into overlapping slabs along their length. parts[].hull is the single whole-part hull the mass comes from.
legs: per leg, the joints from the hip down (hip_yaw, hip_pitch, knee, ankle) with their bones and joints[] index, and the sole socket's name.
sole_* sockets: at the foot's contact centre at the rest pose; forward = toe direction, normal = sole normal (the socket's local up).
